detail: Supported Codex execution events were normalized and hash-bound.
Command, file, MCP, or web activity was observed in item events.
Every supplied communication send had a correlated receive event.
The source stream did not explicitly attest that task content was readable audit text; the adapter does not infer plaintext from a content field (see openai/codex#28058).
The event stream did not expose the offered tool catalog (see openai/codex#31088).
The event stream did not expose the offered skill catalog (see openai/codex#31088).
The event stream did not expose an effective permissions profile.
